cases.study_information: Predict 48-hour RIPA-extracted brain PGRN concentration (pg/mg wet tissue) for sandwich1_h48, sandwich2_h48 and kappa3_h48. Measurements through 24 hours, corresponding 48-hour PBS-soluble values and the older PTV11 profile are visible. Target RIPA and CSF results are withheld. PBS and RIPA are distinct extraction fractions; infer detergent-associated retention without treating the fractions as interchangeable free-drug measurements.
